errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows four bars for each model category, not three. The description then contradicts itself by listing four SFT training conditions.

The value for the LLaMA-2-70B model with '+ SFT on D₀' is stated as 75%, but the bar in the chart is clearly above 80%, at approximately 82%.
The value for the LLaMA-2-7B model with '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' is stated as 74%, but the bar in the chart is clearly above 80%, at approximately 81%.
The value for the LLaMA-2-13B model with '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' is stated as 78%, but the bar in the chart is well above 80%, at approximately 84%.
The value for the LLaMA-2-7B model with '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' is stated as 76%, but the bar in the chart is clearly above 80%, at approximately 83%.

The description fails to mention the distinct fill patterns (diagonal stripes, horizontal stripes, solid) used to differentiate the bars for each SFT condition. These patterns are a key part of the visual encoding shown in the legend.
